text:
## [SECTION 5: Sachayi Ka Khulasa]

Hello doston, mera naam hai Sudhansu aur aap dekh rahe hain Raat 3 Baje. Doston, aaj ki yeh kahani ek aise officer ke anubhav par aadharit hai jise jungle mein kuch ajeeb cheezon ka saamna karna pada. Yeh kahani us waqt ki hai jab wo apni duty nibha rahe the. Aap sabhi logon se meri request hai ki agar aap channel par naye hain toh mere channel ko zaroor subscribe karein. Toh chaliye ab bina waqt zaya kiye aaj ki kahani ko sunte hain. Kehte hain ki sunsaan gumnaam jagah par bhoot preton ka vaas hota hai. Ek waqt tak maine bhi kabhi bhoot pret in cheezon par yaqeen nahi kiya tha. Par ab karta hoon.

Main us darakht ki taraf badhta gaya jahan se wo awaaz sabse zyada saaf aa rahi thi. Mera dil zor-zor se dhadak raha tha. Har kadam ke saath mitti aur purane patton ki boo mere naak mein bhar rahi thi. Aisa lag raha tha jaise koi cheez mujhe rokne ki koshish kar rahi ho. Jab main us bade aur mude hue darakht ke bilkul kareeb pahuncha toh meri aankhon ke saame kuch dikha. Ek purani aur dhool se bhari logbook wahan padi thi. Saath mein ek zang lagi hui metal ki ID card bhi thi. Dono cheezein ek patli tehni par fansi hui thi jaisa lag raha tha jaise koi unhe wahan chhod gaya ho. Maine kaanpte hathon se wo logbook uthayi aur uske pannon ko palatne laga. Usme baar-baar ek hi naam likha tha. Mera naam Aryan wahan saaf dikh raha tha. Lekin wo saal 2016 ka likha hua tha. Jab maine us ID card par nazar dali toh mera sar chakrane laga. Us par bhi mera naam tha magar uska rang aur uski hal lambi haalat bilkul alag thi.

Mujhe us pal ehsas hua ki yeh jungle sirf ek maidan nahi balki waqt ke ek ajeeb mod ka hissa hai. Yeh jagah ek spatial fold kahi jati hai jahan waqt ruk jata hai. Wo awaaz kisi walkie-talkie ya radio se nahi aa rahi thi. Balki woh hawa mein hi phans gayi thi. Har baar jab koi us jagah se guzarta toh wo purana dard dobara zinda ho jata. Mere liye wo sirf ek naam nahi tha balki mere jaisa ek shaks tha jo barson pehle yahan qaid ho gaya tha. Us darakht ke paar ki hawa mein ab bhi uski darr aur tadap maujood thi. Wo sadiyon se wahin ghoonj rahi thi. Mujhe ehsas hua ki agar main wahan thoda sa bhi rukta ya kisi baat ka jawab deta toh shayad main bhi ussi loop ka hissa ban jata. Mere dimaag mein ek hi khayal aa raha tha ki yeh jungle sirf zameen ko nahi balki waqt aur yaadon ko bhi apne andar samet leta hai. Wo awaazein ab mere liye koi rahasya nahi rahi thi. Woh ek khatarnaak sach ban chuki thi jo mujhe yahan se bhagne par majboor kar rahi thi.

Main bina peeche mude apni jeep ki taraf bhaga aur jab main outpost pahuncha toh meri saansein phool rahi thi. Mera shareer tharthar kaamp raha tha. Raat ke sannate mein ab bhi mujhe kabhi-kabhi wo awaaz sunai deti. Aisa lagta jaise koi dur se mera naam pukaar raha ho. Log kehte hain ki kuch jagah aisi hoti hain jo waqt ko rok leti hain. Wahan purani baatein hamesha zinda rehti hain. Ab jab main apni duty par hota hoon ya raat ko sota hoon toh kabhi-kabhi mujhe lagta hai ki mere apne hi sawal hawa mein goonj rahe hain. Main us din ke baad se kisi se bhi us darakht ya logbook ka zikr nahi karta. Kuch baatein sirf dimaag mein rehne par hi sahi hoti hain. Aaj bhi jab main jungle ki gehrai mein jata hoon toh mujhe mehsoos hota hai ki mere peeche koi aur bhi hai. Wo mere jaisa hi naam rakhta hai. Shayad woh isi waqt mujhse baat karna chahta hai.

Doston, zaroori nahi ki jis baat par tum yaqeen nahi karte, woh saari baatein jhooth ho. Kabhi-kabhi doosron ki baaton par bhi yaqeen kar lena chahiye.
summary: Aryan discovers an old logbook and ID from 10 years ago bearing his name at the source of the "echoes," realizing the sounds are a temporal loop rather than a recording, and he escapes while haunted by the realization of the forest's nature.
